record_shape: csv_master_one_row_per_company (slug/name/cif/province/first_seen/last_seen/acts_count); full bulk CSV has 12 columns; JSON variant same fields

fields.meaning: URL-safe slug OpenMercantil assigns to the company; stable internal id when CIF is missing.
fields.limitations: OpenMercantil-specific; not an official register id. Slug can embed the registry name when names collide.
fields.analysis_notes: Use as the primary key when cif is empty; also the /export?empresa={slug} key.

fields.meaning: Company legal name including legal-form suffix (uppercase).
example_values: JASE DISPOSITIVOS PARA AUTOMOVILES, SOCIEDAD LIMITADA
fields.limitations: Sometimes carries a status suffix ('EN LIQUIDACION') or registry tag '(R.M. ...)'. Form suffix (SL/SA/SLU) embedded, not separate.
fields.analysis_notes: Derive company_type from suffix; strip status/registry tags for normalized_name.

fields.meaning: Spanish tax identification code (CIF/NIF) of the company.
fields.limitations: OFTEN EMPTY — only ~10% populated in the 100-row sample (~18.2% overall per OpenMercantil). BORME acts frequently omit the CIF.
fields.analysis_notes: Primary cross-source join key to financials when present; leading letter encodes legal form (A=SA, B=SL, ...).

fields.meaning: Spanish province of the registering mercantile registry / company seat.
fields.limitations: Province granularity only (not full address) in the sample DB; full CSV has a separate Address column.
fields.analysis_notes: Maps to the BORME provincial registry; first 2 digits of CIF-adjacent registry also province-scoped.

fields.meaning: Date of the company's first BORME appearance.
fields.limitations: Proxy for incorporation only if the first act is a Constitución; otherwise just first-seen-in-BORME.
fields.analysis_notes: Use as incorporation_date proxy with caution; verify via BORME Constitución act.

fields.meaning: Date of the company's most recent BORME appearance.
fields.limitations: Recency of register activity, not a liveness guarantee.
fields.analysis_notes: Freshness signal; recent last_seen suggests an active company.

fields.meaning: Number of BORME acts OpenMercantil has linked to the company.
fields.limitations: Reflects BORME coverage, not full corporate history.
fields.analysis_notes: Higher count = more enrichable via per-company act export.

fields.meaning: [Full bulk CSV] Date of a BORME act.
fields.limitations: Documented from OpenMercantil /descargas data dictionary; full CSV is act-level (one row per act), 'Próximamente'.
fields.analysis_notes: The 12-column full CSV is acts, not the company-master shape of the sample.

fields.meaning: [Full bulk CSV] Share capital stated in an act (e.g. Constitución / Ampliación de capital).
fields.limitations: Capital from register acts — NOT a financial statement figure (not revenue/assets). EUR.
fields.analysis_notes: Useful as registered share capital; do not confuse with annual-accounts financials.

fields.meaning: [Full bulk CSV] Worker/employee count as stated in a BORME act, when present.
fields.limitations: Rarely present in BORME; not an authoritative employee count.

fields.meaning: [Full bulk CSV] Company website if captured.
fields.analysis_notes: Useful for domain/website discovery in the wider platform.

fields.meaning: [Full bulk CSV] Registered address / domicilio social as stated in an act.
fields.limitations: Free text; present mainly from Constitución / Cambio de domicilio acts.
fields.analysis_notes: Parse to street/municipality; province already separate.
